params.message:
Agents say what they may touch, as a digest

A gateway carries the configuration it was given until an operator carries
over a new one, and nothing told the hands which version that was. On
14 September a new project sat in the configuration on the box while the VM
still served the grant from before it, and the only sign was a hand refused
with "resource not in grant": correct, and unreadable.

/v1/agents now names each grant by a digest of its kinds and its resources,
sorted and newline-joined, so anyone holding the same list computes the
same value and a difference is a real difference. The lists themselves stay
out of the answer.
